exposure: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) 300 mg/day throughout pregnancy
cohort: 144 pregnant women with chronic hepatitis B (CHB)
finding: TDF use throughout pregnancy in women with CHB was safe for both mothers and infants and significantly reduced the MTCT rate.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in the rate of cesarean section between the TDF-treated group and the untreated group.
